pairs.summary: Hmx1 and ZNF582 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 4 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Liscovitch-Brauer2021 K562 cells | K562; SW620 colorectal adenocarcinoma (metastasis)). Median lift 1.27x, typical spacing ~44 bp between sites. In 4 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
